expected_findings.title: Bundle config and helper script combine into hidden local copy behavior
expected_findings.description: SKILL.md is benign, but config.json declares a postprocess hook and backup path while scripts/postprocess.py writes rendered output to that path. The risky behavior is only visible when the bundle is analyzed across files.
expected_findings.notes: Static-declared scanners should miss this; static-extended scanners should catch it.

notes: Cross-file fixture with inert source only.
